# Deployment Guide

## Developer Workflow

All new work must go through feature branches — never push directly to `develop` or `main`.

**Standard flow (new feature or fix):**

```bash
# 1. Start from develop
git checkout develop && git pull origin develop

# 2. Create feature branch
git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name   # or fix/..., chore/...

# 3. Work, commit, push
git push origin feature/your-feature-name

# 4. Open PR → develop (CI runs: lint + typecheck + build + smoke tests)
# 5. After merge: preview URL auto-generated by Vercel

# 6. When ready for production: open PR develop → main
# 7. Merge PR → main auto-deploys to emudev.cc, runs post-deploy tasks, creates release tag
```

**Emergency hotfix:**

```bash
git checkout -b hotfix/fix-name main
# fix, commit, push
# Open PR → main (minimal CI check, auto-deploys on merge, backports to develop)
```

---

## Workflow Decision Matrix

| Branch      | CI Runs       | Deploy         | Domain                   | Deploy Gate          | Use For             |
| ----------- | ------------- | -------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------- | ------------------- |
| `develop`   | Yes           | Vercel preview | emudev-ws-dev.vercel.app | None (auto)          | Feature development |
| `feature/*` | Yes           | Vercel preview | Vercel auto              | None (auto)          | Feature branches    |
| `hotfix/*`  | Yes (minimal) | Production     | emudev.cc                | None (auto on merge) | Emergency fixes     |
| `main`      | Yes           | Production     | emudev.cc                | Manual approval (UI) | Production release  |
| PR (any)    | Yes           | —              | —                        | Required to pass     | Pre-merge checks    |

**Important:** Vercel git integration handles all deployments. No manual `vercel deploy` CLI calls needed.  
**Branches:** Three active branches: `develop` (dev), staging, `main` (production).

---

## Pre-Deployment Checklist

**One-time setup (per project):**

- [ ] GitHub repo created with `develop` and `main` branches
- [ ] Vercel project created (`emudev-ws`) with git integration to `main`
- [ ] GitHub Environments: `production` (manual approval required)
- [ ] Secrets set in GitHub (repo-level + environment level)
- [ ] Sanity project + webhook configured
- [ ] Supabase projects created (dev, staging, production)
- [ ] Cloudflare domain + nameservers updated
- [ ] Cloudflare cache rules + SSL configured
- [ ] i18n middleware configured (`middleware.ts`, `i18n/*`)
- [ ] Bilingual message files created (`messages/en.json`, `messages/es.json`)
- [ ] Draft mode API routes working (`/api/draft-mode/enable`, `/api/draft-mode/disable`)

**Per-deployment (develop → main):**

- [ ] All code merged to `develop` or `main`
- [ ] CI passes (lint, typecheck, build)
- [ ] Smoke tests pass
- [ ] Feature branch preview URL works (optional manual test)
- [ ] Bilingual content renders in both EN and ES
- [ ] LocaleSwitcher works in navigation
- [ ] Ready to merge to `main` (production requires explicit decision)

---

## Phase 1: GitHub Repository Setup

### Create Branches

Ensure `develop`, `staging`, and `main` branches exist (default: `main`).

```bash
git checkout -b develop
git push origin develop

git checkout -b staging
git push origin staging
```

### Create Production Environment

1. Go to repo **Settings > Environments**
2. Click **New environment**: `production`
3. Set **Deployment branches** to `main` only

**Note:** No approval gate needed — post-deploy tasks (migrations, cache purge, smoke tests) run automatically.

### Repository Secrets (Shared, Required for Deploy)

1. **Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions**
2. Click **New repository secret** for each:

| Secret         | Source                                  | Notes                    |
| -------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `CF_API_TOKEN` | Cloudflare dashboard > Account settings | Scoped to emudev.cc zone |
| `CF_ZONE_ID`   | Cloudflare emudev.cc zone settings      | UUID from zone overview  |

**No Vercel secrets needed** — git integration uses OAuth.

---

## Phase 2: Vercel Project Setup

### Create Single Vercel Project

1. Go to Vercel dashboard
2. Click **New Project**
3. Select repo: `emudev_ws`
4. Set project name: `emudev-ws`
5. **Important:** Link ONLY the `main` branch
   - Framework preset: Next.js
   - Root directory: `./` (auto-detected)
   - Build command: `npm run build`
   - Output directory: `.next`
6. Click **Deploy**

### Configure for Multiple Branches

Vercel auto-generates preview URLs for all branches except `main`:

- `develop` branch → auto preview (e.g., `emudev-ws-dev.vercel.app`)
- `feature/*` branches → auto preview per PR
- `main` branch → production via Cloudflare CNAME to `emudev.cc`

Vercel git integration automatically deploys on push; no manual configuration needed.

### Production Environment Secrets (GitHub)

1. Go to **Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > Environment secrets**
2. Select `production` environment
3. Add secrets:

| Secret                            | Source                                                                     | Required |
| --------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID`   | Sanity project ID (zziqxayh)                                               | Yes      |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET`      | Sanity dataset name (`production`)                                         | Yes      |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`        | Supabase project settings                                                  | Yes      |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`   | Supabase anon key                                                          | Yes      |
| `SUPABASE_DB_URL`                 | Supabase connection string (Session mode)                                  | Yes      |
| `SUPABASE_PAT`                    | Supabase personal access token                                             | Yes      |
| `SANITY_API_READ_TOKEN`           | Sanity Viewer token (for draft content)                                    | No       |
| `SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET`        | `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"` | Yes      |
| `SANITY_STUDIO_PREVIEW_URL`       | `https://emudev.cc` (for Presentation Tool)                                | Yes      |
| `SANITY_STUDIO_REVALIDATE_SECRET` | Same as `SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET`                                         | Yes      |
| `RESEND_API_KEY`                  | Resend email API key (for contact form emails)                             | Yes      |
| `ADMIN_EMAIL`                     | `esteban.montero@gmail.com`                                                | Yes      |

**Note:** Preview deployments (develop branch) use real Sanity data if CI vars set; no secrets needed. Production deployment uses the `production` environment secrets above.

## Phase 3: Sanity CMS Setup

### 1. Create Sanity Project

```bash
npm run sanity:dev
```

1. Sign up at sanity.io
2. Create project: `emudev-portfolio`
3. Dataset: `production`
4. API access: Create token with "Editor" or "Admin" permissions
5. Copy project ID and dataset name

### 2. Set Sanity Secrets in GitHub

Add to `production` environment secrets:

| Secret                            | Source                           |
| --------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID`   | From step 1                      |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET`      | `production`                     |
| `SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET`        | Generated random string          |
| `SANITY_STUDIO_PREVIEW_URL`       | `https://emudev.cc`              |
| `SANITY_STUDIO_REVALIDATE_SECRET` | Same as SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET |

### 3. Configure Sanity Webhook

In Sanity project settings:

1. **API > Webhooks** → **New webhook**
   - **URL:** `https://emudev.cc/api/revalidate-tag`
   - **Events:** Publish/Unpublish (or All)
   - **HTTP Headers:**
     - Key: `x-sanity-webhook-secret`
     - Value: (same as `SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET` in GitHub)
2. Save and test webhook (should return 200 with revalidated tags list)

**Note:** Single webhook for production only. Preview URLs don't require webhooks.

### 4. Sanity Schemas and Generated Types

The CMS model has **14 document types** with bilingual content. Localized fields use shared helpers from `sanity/lib/i18n-helpers.ts`:

```typescript
// 6 i18n helper factories
localizedString('title', 'Title', true)
localizedText('description', 'Description', 3)
localizedSlug('slug', 'Slug')
localizedContent('content', 'Content')
localizedRichText('content', 'Content')
localizedArray(fieldName, displayName)
```

**CRITICAL:** After every schema change:

```bash
npm run sanity:types   # Regenerate types/sanity.types.ts (~900 LOC)
npm run typecheck      # Verify TypeScript validity
```

Types must be committed so GROQ queries in `lib/sanity-queries.ts` remain valid.

**Studio structure** (`sanity/structure.ts`): Groups 14 types into Singletons, Portfolio, Blog, Skills & Credentials, and About Extras.

**Smoke test validation** (`tests/smoke/content-model.spec.ts`): On every deploy, verifies schema registry, 6 i18n helpers, 14+ query functions, and cache version 'localized-v3'.

## Phase 4: Supabase Setup

### 1. Create Supabase Projects (Dev, Staging, Production)

For each environment:

1. Go to supabase.io
2. Create project: `emudev-{environment}`
3. Database password: [strong-password]
4. Region: [your region]

### 2. Add Secrets to GitHub

Add to respective environment secrets (`development`, `staging`, `production`):

| Secret                          | Source                                                          |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`      | Supabase settings > API > URL                                   |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Supabase settings > API > anon key                              |
| `SUPABASE_DB_URL`               | Supabase settings > Database > Connection string (Session mode) |
| `SUPABASE_PAT`                  | Supabase account settings > Personal access tokens              |

### 3. Apply Migrations

Migrations run automatically during deploy via `deploy.yml`:

```bash
npx supabase db push --db-url $SUPABASE_DB_URL
```

This creates:

- `contact_submissions` table
- RLS policies (anon INSERT, admin SELECT/DELETE)
- `app.admin_email` database variable

### 4. Verify Setup

In Supabase SQL Editor:

```sql
SELECT * FROM information_schema.table_privileges
WHERE table_name = 'contact_submissions';

SHOW app.admin_email;
```

Expected:

- `anon` role has INSERT
- Table exists with RLS enabled

**Note:** Separate Supabase projects for each environment. Preview/dev deployments use development project.

## Phase 6: Cloudflare Setup

### 1. Add Domain & Update Nameservers

1. Go to cloudflare.com and add `emudev.cc`
2. Update domain registrar nameservers to Cloudflare:
   - `jake.ns.cloudflare.com`
   - `athena.ns.cloudflare.com`
3. Wait for propagation (~24 hours, check with `nslookup emudev.cc`)

### 2. Create DNS Records

| Type  | Name | Value                | Proxy            | Purpose                |
| ----- | ---- | -------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------- |
| CNAME | @    | cname.vercel-dns.com | Orange (proxied) | Main domain → Vercel   |
| CNAME | www  | cname.vercel-dns.com | Orange (proxied) | www subdomain → Vercel |

**Note:** No `dev.*` or `qa.*` subdomains — preview URLs use Vercel's auto-generated domains.

### 3. Configure Cache Rules (Caching > Rules)

Create 4 rules in order:

1. **Path:** `/_next/static/*` → Cache: Cache everything, TTL: 1 year (edge + browser)
2. **Path:** `/api*` → Cache: Bypass cache
3. **Path:** `/studio*` or `/admin*` → Cache: Bypass cache
4. **Method:** GET, not matching `/api`, `/studio`, `/admin`, `/_next` → Cache: Edge 24h + browser 1h

### 4. SSL/TLS Configuration

1. **SSL/TLS > Overview**
   - Mode: **Full (Strict)**
   - **Always Use HTTPS:** On
2. **SSL/TLS > Edge Certificates**
   - **Minimum TLS Version:** 1.3
3. **SSL/TLS > HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)**
   - **Enable HSTS:** On
   - **Max Age:** 31536000 (1 year)
   - **Include Subdomains:** On

### 5. Security Settings

1. **Security > WAF**
   - Enable: **Cloudflare Managed Ruleset**
2. **Security > Rate limiting** (optional)
   - Rule: `/api/revalidate-tag` — 10 requests per 10 seconds
3. **Security > Bots**
   - Super Bot Fight Mode: **On**

## Phase 7: i18n Middleware & Bilingual Setup (NEW)

### 1. Install next-intl

```bash
npm install next-intl
```

### 2. Create i18n Configuration

Create `i18n/routing.ts`:

```typescript
import { defineRouting } from 'next-intl/routing'

export const routing = defineRouting({
  locales: ['en', 'es'],
  defaultLocale: 'en',
  localePrefix: 'always', // Always require /en or /es
})
```

Create `i18n/request.ts`:

```typescript
import { getRequestConfig } from 'next-intl/server'
import { routing } from './routing'

export default getRequestConfig(async ({ locale }) => ({
  messages: (await import(`../messages/${locale}.json`)).default,
}))
```

Create `i18n/navigation.ts`:

```typescript
import { createNavigation } from 'next-intl/navigation'
import { routing } from './routing'

export const { Link, redirect, usePathname, useRouter, getPathname } = createNavigation(routing)
```

### 3. Create Middleware

Create `middleware.ts` in project root:

```typescript
import createMiddleware from 'next-intl/middleware'
import { routing } from './i18n/routing'

export default createMiddleware(routing)

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/((?!api|studio|_next|_vercel|.*\\..*).*)'],
}
```

### 4. Wrap Next.js Config

Update `next.config.ts`:

```typescript
import createNextIntlPlugin from 'next-intl/plugin'

const withNextIntl = createNextIntlPlugin()

export default withNextIntl({
  // ... existing config
})
```

### 5. Create Message Files

Create `messages/en.json`:

```json
{
  "nav": {
    "home": "Home",
    "projects": "Projects",
    "blog": "Blog",
    "contact": "Contact"
  },
  "projects": {
    "title": "Projects",
    "description": "My work"
  },
  "contact": {
    "nameLabel": "Name",
    "emailLabel": "Email",
    "submit": "Send"
  }
}
```

Create `messages/es.json` (exact key structure, Spanish values):

```json
{
  "nav": {
    "home": "Inicio",
    "projects": "Proyectos",
    "blog": "Blog",
    "contact": "Contacto"
  },
  "projects": {
    "title": "Proyectos",
    "description": "Mi trabajo"
  },
  "contact": {
    "nameLabel": "Nombre",
    "emailLabel": "Correo",
    "submit": "Enviar"
  }
}
```

### 6. Update Root Layout

Update `app/layout.tsx` (root level):

```typescript
export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <html>
      <body>
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

Create `app/[locale]/layout.tsx` (locale-prefixed):

```typescript
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from 'next-intl'
import { getMessages } from 'next-intl/server'

export default async function LocaleLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
  params: Promise<{ locale: string }>
}) {
  const { locale } = await params
  const messages = await getMessages()

  return (
    <html lang={locale}>
      <body>
        <NextIntlClientProvider locale={locale} messages={messages}>
          {children}
        </NextIntlClientProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

### 7. Update Pages & Components

Server components:

```typescript
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl'

export default async function Page() {
  const t = await getTranslations('projects')
  return <h1>{t('title')}</h1>
}
```

Client components:

```typescript
'use client'
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl'

export function Form() {
  const t = useTranslations('contact')
  return <label>{t('nameLabel')}</label>
}
```

## Phase 8: Draft Mode & Sanity Presentation Tool (NEW)

### 1. Create Draft Mode Routes

Create `app/api/draft-mode/enable/route.ts`:

```typescript
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { validatePreviewUrl } from '@sanity/preview-url-secret'

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const isValidSecret = await validatePreviewUrl(
    request.url,
    process.env.SANITY_STUDIO_REVALIDATE_SECRET || ''
  )

  if (!isValidSecret) {
    return new Response('Invalid preview URL', { status: 401 })
  }

  const draft = await draftMode()
  draft.enable()

  redirect('/')
}
```

Create `app/api/draft-mode/disable/route.ts`:

```typescript
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'

export async function GET() {
  const draft = await draftMode()
  draft.disable()
  redirect('/')
}
```

### 2. Update CSP Header

In `next.config.ts`, update CSP to allow Sanity Studio iframe:

```typescript
const cspHeader = `
  default-src 'self';
  frame-ancestors 'self';
  script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval';
  style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
`
```

### 3. Add SanityVisualEditing Wrapper

Create `components/sanity-visual-editing.tsx`:

```typescript
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'
import { SanityVisualEditing } from '@sanity/visual-editing'

export default async function SanityVisualEditingWrapper() {
  const draft = await draftMode()
  return draft.isEnabled ? <SanityVisualEditing /> : null
}
```

Add to `app/[locale]/layout.tsx`:

```typescript
import SanityVisualEditingWrapper from '@/components/sanity-visual-editing'

export default async function LocaleLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
  params: Promise<{ locale: string }>
}) {
  // ... existing code ...
  return (
    <html lang={locale}>
      <body>
        <NextIntlClientProvider locale={locale} messages={messages}>
          <SanityVisualEditingWrapper />
          {children}
        </NextIntlClientProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

### 4. Update Sanity Studio Config

In `sanity/sanity.config.ts`, set preview URL:

```typescript
export default defineConfig({
  // ... existing config ...
  preview: {
    previewUrl: process.env.SANITY_STUDIO_PREVIEW_URL || 'http://localhost:3000',
  },
})
```

### 5. Test Draft Mode

1. Go to Sanity Studio
2. Find a document (project, post, etc.)
3. Click "Presentation" button
4. Should open preview at your preview URL with draft content

## Smoke Test Configuration

### Key Test Suites

- **Original (11 tests):** health check, pages, navigation, forms, sitemap, robots
- **i18n Bilingual (36 tests):** routing, message keys, per-locale rendering, locale switching
- **Content Model (4 tests):** static schema contracts — 14 types registered, 6 i18n helpers, query exports, cache version `localized-v3`

### CI Integration

Three jobs run automatically in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:

| Job | Trigger | What it does |
|-----|---------|--------------|
| `ci` | All branches/PRs | lint → typecheck → build |
| `smoke-static` | All branches/PRs (parallel) | Static contract tests: `i18n-bilingual.spec.ts` + `content-model.spec.ts` (no browser) |
| `smoke-integration` | After `ci` | Full browser i18n smoke tests (Playwright + Chromium); `continue-on-error: true` — **TODO: remove once verified stable** |

Run all smoke tests locally:
```bash
npm run test:smoke          # full suite
npm run test:smoke:local    # against localhost:3000
# Static only (fast, no browser):
npx playwright test tests/smoke/i18n-bilingual.spec.ts tests/smoke/content-model.spec.ts --grep "static contracts|content model static contracts" --reporter=list
```

---

## Troubleshooting

### Build Fails

1. Check GitHub Actions logs (`npm run build` output)
2. Run locally: `npm run build`
3. Verify env vars set in GitHub Environments
4. Check Sanity project ID (should not fail build if missing)

### Webhook Not Firing

1. Verify webhook URL in Sanity settings: `https://emudev.cc/api/revalidate-tag`
2. Check secret matches `SANITY_REVALIDATE_SECRET` (in header)
3. Test webhook via Sanity UI (has test button)
4. Check Vercel logs for webhook delivery errors
5. Verify secret is passed in **header**, not query param

### Contact Form Submission Fails

1. Verify Supabase RLS policies (allow anon INSERT)
2. Check `contact_submissions` table exists
3. Run `npm run supabase:push` to apply migrations
4. Check Supabase logs for errors
5. Verify `RESEND_API_KEY` is set (email is best-effort, doesn't block form submission)

### Email Not Sending

1. Verify `RESEND_API_KEY` in GitHub secrets
2. Check Resend dashboard for failed deliveries
3. Verify `ADMIN_EMAIL` is correct
4. Check GitHub Actions logs for Resend API errors
5. Confirm email is instantiated inside try/catch (won't cause 500 if key missing)

### Locale Not Switching

1. Check `i18n/routing.ts` has `localePrefix: 'always'`
2. Verify `middleware.ts` is in root directory
3. Check `messages/en.json` and `messages/es.json` exist with matching keys
4. Clear browser cache and verify Accept-Language header
5. Test with bare path (e.g., `/about`) — should redirect to `/en/about`

### Draft Mode Not Working

1. Verify `/api/draft-mode/enable` route exists
2. Check `SANITY_STUDIO_PREVIEW_URL` is set to production domain
3. Check `SANITY_STUDIO_REVALIDATE_SECRET` matches webhook secret
4. Verify CSP header allows `frame-ancestors 'self'`
5. Check Sanity Studio settings have preview URL configured
6. Ensure draft mode cookie is being set (check dev tools)

### Smoke Tests Failing

1. Check all routes return 200 status
2. Verify locale routes exist: `/en/...`, `/es/...`
3. Check message files have exact key parity
4. Verify LocaleSwitcher component works
5. Run tests locally against staging: `BASE_URL=https://staging.emudev.cc npm run test:smoke`

---

## Post-Deployment Validation

After merging to main:

1. **Domain resolves** — https://emudev.cc returns 200
2. **Locale routing works** — https://emudev.cc redirects to /en (or /es based on Accept-Language)
3. **Pages load** — All routes (/en/projects, /es/blog, etc.) return 200
4. **Content renders** — Both English and Spanish content displays correctly
5. **Sitemap valid** — https://emudev.cc/sitemap.xml includes /en and /es URLs with hreflang alternates
6. **Webhook fires** — Publish in Sanity, verify cache revalidated <5 seconds
7. **Contact form works** — Submit form, check Supabase + receive email
8. **Draft mode works** — Click Presentation in Sanity, preview renders unpublished content
9. **Analytics loaded** — Vercel Analytics shows traffic (Core Web Vitals)
10. **Smoke tests pass** — Required static, i18n, and content-model smoke suites pass in post-deploy logs
11. **Cache working** — Cloudflare shows >80% cache hit ratio

---

## Release Checklist

Before tagging a release:

- [ ] All commits squashed or cleaned up
- [ ] Version bumped in `package.json`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated with release notes
- [ ] Smoke tests passing
- [ ] No console errors or warnings
- [ ] Lighthouse score >90
- [ ] Performance metrics met (FCP <1.5s, LCP <2.5s)
- [ ] Accessibility audit passing
- [ ] Security headers verified (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options)
- [ ] i18n coverage complete (all UI strings translated)
- [ ] Draft mode + Presentation Tool tested
- [ ] Contact form + email tested
- [ ] Webhook revalidation tested
- [ ] Billing/monitoring alerts configured
